key_validations.honesty_principle: ✅ Models without BOM correctly show status='no_bom' and don't fake numbers. Margin only shown when both price AND HPP are known (margin_known flag).
key_validations.source_badges: ✅ Backend returns source information for all cost components (CMT, internal labor, material costs). Frontend displays source badges.
key_validations.gaps_actionable: ✅ Gaps include code, message, action, and target screen. Each gap is actionable with clear next steps.
key_validations.overhead_optional: ✅ Overhead is optional (default OFF). Can be toggled ON/OFF. HPP calculation correctly includes/excludes overhead.
key_validations.idempotent_apply: ✅ Apply endpoint is idempotent - calling twice with same data produces same result (HPP=6000.0).
key_validations.bom_requirement_honest: ✅ BOM requirement endpoint returns gaps when model has no BOM, size not selected, or fabric not in BOM. Never returns empty silently.
key_validations.size_id_support: ✅ POST /api/cutting/orders accepts size_id parameter directly for models with BOM but no variant.
